name: Media.io
original_description: Create images and videos with model selection across a static catalog of 127 model-operation entries. Generate from text, images or declared mixed references, transfer motion from a video, or create a music video from an image and audio. Reuse private Media.io drive files, view paginated history cards, monitor tasks and display finished media. Check existing credits and estimate costs when requested. Generation consumes existing account credits and entitlements; models and options are limited to the current tool schemas.
